result.summary: The page is mostly intact, but there are a few visual/content issues: a restaurant name is truncated in the 'Fastest near you' section, and the bottom of the scrollable content appears cut off behind the bottom navigation bar.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' in the 'Fastest near you' carousel is truncated, likely missing the final letter(s).
issues.suggestion: Use text truncation with ellipsis (e.g., 'Trattoria Picco...') or wrap/adjust the layout so the full name is readable.

issues.description: The second restaurant card in 'Popular right now' (pizza with '-20%' tag) is partially cut off at the bottom of the screen behind the bottom navigation bar.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding or safe-area inset to the scrollable content so the last card is fully visible above the tab bar.

issues.description: The time/delivery badges on the restaurant cards have varying vertical/horizontal positions, which makes the row feel slightly unaligned.
issues.suggestion: Standardize badge placement across all card sizes to create a consistent visual rhythm.
